full_judgment: These two Rules issued in Civil Revision No. 26 of 1985 and Civil Revision No. 27 of 1985 at the instance of pre-emptor Abdul Malek are directed against one and the same judgment and order passed in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 196 of 1982 and Miscellaneous Appeal No. 197 of 1982 on 12.9.84. by the Subordinate Judge, Jhalakati affirming the analogous judgment and order passed on 20.9.82 by the Munsif, Jhalakati disallowing Miscellaneous Case Nos. 186 of 1975 and 187 or 1975 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Both the Rules are being disposed of by this judgment.
